verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents bulk or batch operations, meaning acting on many items at once such as mass-approving, mass-categorizing or mass-editing expenses. The AI assistant claims (create, categorize, approve via plain language) and automatic workflows (auto-submit, auto-export) describe per-item or rule-driven automation, not user-initiated bulk actions. The API mention of programmatically downloading report data is an export capability, not a bulk operation, so it is adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
